using Base64, MPI
MPI.Init()
comm = MPI.COMM_WORLD
rank = MPI.Comm_rank(comm)
root = joinpath(get(ENV, "WORK", "/tmp"), "mb2d_" * get(ENV, "SLURM_JOB_ID", "x"))
if rank == 0
    mkpath(root)
    write(joinpath(root, "p.tgz"), base64decode(""))
    run(`tar -xzf $(joinpath(root, "p.tgz")) -C $root`)
end
MPI.Barrier(comm)
dir = joinpath(root, "b")
for _ in 1:60
    isfile(joinpath(dir, "bench2gpu_ddp.jl")) && isfile(joinpath(dir, "mlp3b_ddp.jl")) && break
    sleep(1)
end
ENV["STADE_NTOTS"] = "8192,1024,32,256,32768,32,8192,1024"
empty!(ARGS); append!(ARGS, ["mpibatch", dir])
include(joinpath(dir, "bench2gpu_ddp.jl"))
